newsitem.title: USA: United Video to pursue spin-off of Superstar stake.
newsitem.headline: United Video to pursue spin-off of Superstar stake.

text.p: United Video Satellite Group Inc Friday said it will pursue a potential spin-off of its 50 percent stake in Superstar/Netlink Group 's retail satellite business.
The potential spin off will be subject to the company obtaining a favorable private letter ruling from the U.S. Internal Revenue Service in order to accomplish the transaction on a tax free basis.
"We believe that our (stake) is a valuable asset that the investment community is not fully recognizing as part of UVSG," said Lawrence Flinn, Jr., chairman and chief executive officer of UVSG.
